title: Chapter 459
paragraphs: Chapter 459
Episode 131. People with good intuition, people with bad intuition (3)
As Gilly went out to prepare for Jin's trip, Murakan came to his room.
He made a forced grimace (to make her laugh) and rolled his eyes when he met Gilly on his way in, but she just bowed her head and passed by.
"Hmm, judging by the reaction of the Strawberry Pie today, I can sense 20% displeasure, 30% sadness, and 50% bitterness. There's not an inch of error in this calculation, kid. Do you know that?"
"What nonsense are you talking about, again?"
"Well, what would you know? Tsk. You just know how to enjoy Strawberry Pie."
A vein bulged on his forehead.
"Does the great Black Dragon not know how to throw a shabby compliment?"
"What compliment? What shabby compliment?"
"Adding cheap jokes, too."
"You don't know how much Strawberry Pie laughs at those jokes."
"Yeah, I don't need those jokes. Gilly laughs just by looking at my face."
"Ha! Look at you talking! There's nothing to see in you, even as a thousand-year contractor. I raised you wrong. I should've known when you threatened to shut down the Chunhwa House back then!"
"Really? Murakan, it would be nice if you showed me something good now. Why are you scratching at me, getting on my nerves when I'm already frustrated?"
"Oh, my goodness."
"Because I can give you a reason."
Then Murakan made a typical fake cough.
"Cough, cough, cough, ahem."
Jin burst into a small laugh.
"Go and help Strawberry Pie, no, Gilly."
That was the reason.
Without this reason, if he told Gilly he would help her, he would only hear, "It's okay, don't worry about it."
On the other hand, if he had a reason, he could say, "Oh, from my lord?" and have a natural collaboration.
"Hehehe, good. You brat, kiddo. That's a very satisfying story. Then, while you go looking for Amel or Camel or whatever, I'll catch up on housework with Strawberry Pie..."
"You're coming with me too. And there's never been any backlog of housework."
"Yes, I'm coming too... Why, why?"
"Aren't you a guardian dragon?"
"Well, yes, but there are times when you need some privacy, too."
"I'd like to respect your expectations, but this time we have to go together. It could be quite dangerous."
"It seems like it would be okay as long as someone like Zephrin doesn't pop up, right? Wouldn't it be better for Mr. Murakan to just protect Tikan?"
"There's no guarantee that Zephrin won't pop up again. And we need a proper halo in the Gaipa Province."
At the mention of a halo, Murakan's eyebrows twitched.
"A halo? Are you saying you'll use me as a halo?"
"Yes. When we go to Gaipa Province, all four major powers will be gathered there. There will be prominent figures representing them."
"So you're saying you don't want to be pushed around among them."
In fact, even without Murakan, it was unlikely that Jin would be looked down upon by anyone, even without Lata and Fey.
Just 1 or 2 years ago, there would have been many who thought, "He's just from the 12th class."
But now, Jin had risen to the ranks of the real heavyweight.
He had been an extraordinary rookie who shook the world and caused a sensation, but after devouring the Ghost Corps and the Black King Group, he had become an indisputable heavyweight.
So even without Murakan, his status wouldn't be pushed back, but it was better to have more.
Fierce beasts from all over the world gathered in the small cage of Gaipa Province.
A tiny spark could lead to a mad battle, meaning Jin and the Proch siblings alone might not be enough. The enemies would likely have their subordinate soldiers with them.
"Right. We also need to be prepared for any contingencies."
"Well, I can manage one big fight."
"Anyway, are you going? I'll have various phrases prepared for you to use in different situations in Gaipa Province when you come back after helping Gilly."
"Phrases? What phrases?"
"Yeah, that sort of thing."
Here, in Gaipa Province, there was a transparent sea, a calm and warm wind that blew all year round, a forest full of sea views, trees filled with tempting fruits, and unknown wild animals.
It was a truly useless area.
The nearby sea was calm, but as soon as you left the province, there were terrible currents and unidentified whirlpools, so normal boat routes couldn't be established.
The warm wind that blew every day was unsuitable for setting up a transportation gate, as it would suddenly cover the island with dry sand and water droplets.
The colorful lands were pointless, yielding only a meaningless level of resources when dug up.
Moreover, there were even mysterious endemic diseases that circulated every year, making it impossible for many people to live in groups. Those who came to settle couldn't endure for long periods.

The cherry on top was the presence of monsters. Gaipa Province was an unprotected area. It wasn't classified as a super-dangerous area, but once or twice a week, monsters like orcs would roam the island.
Thus, Gaipa Province could not be used as a tourist destination, a residential area, or even a retreat for the wealthy.
Occasionally, there were those who invested in the island, breaking through all these adverse conditions, or those who secured personal spaces.
However, even those disappeared after Amella, the mercenary, settled in this huge and useless province about thirty years ago.
Chalbang, Charureung...
The boat gently cut through the foggy sea.
The one who explained all this while rowing the boat alone on the way to the island was Lata Proch.
"Several rumors circulated about the reason, my lord."
"Are you talking about the reason why people approaching Gaipa Island decreased after Amela arrived?"
"There were rumors that Amela hid something on the island and killed everyone who came looking for it. They hid their lovers, kidnapped children, and such things."
"Of course, there must have been stories about hiding treasure as well."
"Yes. So quite a few mercenaries and pirates came to Gaipa Island. They were all foolish... and none of them were ever seen again."
If one or two people disappeared, it might be different, but if an entire group disappeared, it had to be Amela's doing.
"Every once in a while, those who were lucky enough to come back alive showed fear-stricken faces even at the mere mention of Amela."
The false rumors about Amela wearing human skin or practicing cannibalism started from such phenomena.
"One thing is clear: Amela really hates guests coming to the island."
As they left the foggy area, Gaipa Island came into view.
"That's right."
More guests had gathered on Gaipa Island than ever before.
Lata was certain. Amela would not meet the guests.
However, if they did meet, it would surely be for war, not hospitality.
"By the way, there's a rumor that Amela... um... has a fondness for Lata and Fey."
"Please don't mind what Sir Valkas said and don't worry about our feelings, Lord Jin."
Fey said. They had heard the same story from Valkas before departure. Then she added:

"And I'm not sure if we can call it 'fondness.' Sir Valkas might have said that because he thought of a time when we all happened to have a meal together on the battlefield. My brother and I have seen Amela quite often apart from that day."
"If it's not fondness, then what is it?"
"It's hard to describe with words. I guess they seemed to think of us as toys or playmates. They would say they were bored but swing their swords around."
"Embarrassingly, I once got my forehead cut in one of those surprise attacks."
At that point.
Jin was able to realize what the strange sense of familiarity he felt while hearing about Amela was.
The ambiguous boundary between good and evil, and the behavior of possibly killing others under the guise of playing.
There was such a person among the people Jin loved.
'Lady Yona.'
So far, Amela had quite a few similarities with Yona based on what he had heard.
And naturally, a word comes to mind.
Chaos.
'Maybe Amela, like Lady Yona, is also imbued with chaos.'
Of course, they could just be a person with a twisted personality, but other circumstances fit well too.
The part about overwhelming the entire Black King's Party single-handedly in a war was also the case.
Valkas assessed that Amela was not a transcendent martial artist above level 10 but possessed a special ability.

-Amela has been wandering and exploring the world all their life. After the battle was over, when we had a meal together, I casually asked and they seemed to be searching for something with great passion... but they didn't tell me exactly what it was.
Jin recalled what Valkas had said.
Sharp intuition felt like it was piercing his head from all directions.
'What Amela is looking for is something related to chaos.'
The origin of chaos within themselves, the reason, or a way to control or eliminate it.
'If what Amela is looking for is that, what can I give?'
Jin didn't know much about the information on 'chaos'. What Talaris had told him recently was almost all he knew.
On the other hand, how much did their enemies know?
Even if the royal family didn't know, Kinzelo and Zipfel seemed to have more information than he did. Especially since the leader of Kinzelo was a person presumed to be at the level of a demon lord.
'If Amela's goal is really information about chaos, I'm in a very disadvantageous position. I'm already late to arrive at the island.'
At that moment.
A familiar sight entered Jin and his party's eyes. From the middle of Gaipa Island in front of them, dark smoke and flames began to rise.
Needless to say, the smoke signified that a battle was taking place. And it unfolded quickly enough to be visible.
"My lord."
"What should we do?"
When Lata and Fey asked, Jin immediately made a decision.
If there had been only one major force that had come to Gaipa Island, he would have rushed to see it right away.
Because it would be a fight between Amela and the major force.
But it wasn't the case now.
It could be a fight among the major forces, a fight involving Amela, or a fight between Amela and some of the major forces.
And they all wanted Amela.
As long as the four major powers didn't join forces to take down Amela, she was actually the safest in any situation. Because anyone would try to save her.
"Let's move in more slowly. And if possible, let's hide somewhere suitable and take a look at how they are fighting each other."
